decisions.rationale: 2025 NOA, pay stub run-rate and employer letter salary of $93,364 support the stated $88,500.
Seasoned chequing history with a $235,660 balance and no unusual deposits covers the $217,500 down payment plus closing costs.
Employment letter was sent from a personal mail account with no company letterhead.
Credit score of 574 is below the 600 minimum even though GDS (about 32-34%) and TDS (about 37%) are within limits.
